scope: All 21 supplied training label files; Car only; every consecutive index pair from zero through each file maximum frame; ground-truth boxes as geometry, no detector or persistent tracker. No identity-based selection.
ordering: Lexicographic (cx, cy, width, height), never identity or annotation order. Duplicate geometry rejected to avoid unspecified identity-bearing ties.
sensitivity: One factor at a time: penalty 400000 or 800000, distance gate 40 or 160 px (including its normalization), IoU gate 0 or 0.2. No selection of best setting after results.
evaluation: IDs used after both predictions only. Eligible = same Car identity observed in both consecutive frames, including gated-out pairs. Precision correct/predicted; recall correct/eligible; undefined denominators NaN.
timing: Baseline only. steady_clock; one pilot then 3 batches, each targeting 200 us with cap 64; allocation, box checks, cost construction and assignment included; parse, ordering, ID evaluation, CSV and certificates excluded. Median per pair, then median over active pairs. Alternate method order by frame parity.
subgroups: Current detection occlusion codes 0,1,2,3; truncation codes 0,1,2; size height <40 vs >=40 px; crowding max(previous,current) <=4 vs 5-8 vs >=9. Descriptive, no inferential test.
